description:
Experience the Freego Landtiger electric scooter—powered by a robust 4000W dual motor, foldable for easy storage, and equipped with a comfortable seat. Perfect for commuting or adventurous rides. Ride smarter with Freego!

Mode D11 D11 Pro

Max speed 2 working modes available.
Sports mode(dual motor): Top speed 56mph 2 working modes available.

Motor Power Output 2000w (nominal), 4000w (peak) Dual Motor
hub brushless direct drive motor (DC) 2000w (nominal), 4000w (peak) Dual Motor
hub brushless direct drive motor (DC)

Battery 60V, 26Ah(1560Wh) 60V, 50Ah(3000Wh)

Charging Time 5-8 H 7-10 H

Controller Brushless Motor 40A x 2 Controllers Brushless Motor 40A x 2 Controllers

Motor Activation Conditions/Modes Triggered by either an electric throttle only Triggered by either an electric throttle only

Throttle Type Thumb throttle Thumb throttle

Frame Material High-strength Steel Pipe High-strength Steel Pipe

Max Load 440lbs (200kg) 440lbs (200kg)

Net Weight 110 Lbs (50kg) 125 Lbs (57kg)

Package Size 59*13.8*24 inch (150*35*60cm), Weight 128Lbs 59*13.8*24 inch (150*35*60cm). Weight 142Lbs

Transmission Gears Hub direct-drive brushless motors on both the front and rear wheels. No speed reduction is required. Hub direct-drive brushless motors on both the front and rear wheels. No speed reduction is required.

Brake System Front & rear wheels hydraulic disc brakes.
2-piston hydraulic disc brakes + 160mm disc rotors Front & rear wheels hydraulic disc brakes.
2-piston hydraulic disc brakes + 160mm disc rotors

Suspension Hydraulic front & rear shock absorbers Hydraulic front & rear shock absorbers

Light 3 LED headlights & 1 rear brake light and LED acrylic ambient lights 3 LED headlights & 1 rear brake light and LED acrylic ambient lights

Suggested Rider Height 5'3"-6'3" (160-190cm) 5'3"-6'3" (160-190cm)

Wheel Material Aluminum alloy Aluminum alloy

Tire Size 100/65 -6.5(11x4 inch) 100/65 -6.5(11x4 inch)

Tire Types Tubeless tire with puncture-resistant Tubeless tire with puncture-resistant
